system.description:
Boil Release: Erupting Steam Wall · cast at S-Rank · no type

50 temporary hit points; at the start of each of your turns you regain them up to 50.

A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 25 acid damage.

When you take damage from an attack, you can expel the barrier as a shockwave: each creature within 10 feet takes the acid damage.
